# opsramp_tenant (Data Source)

Retrieves information about the current authenticated tenant.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the tenant.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the tenant.



## Example Usage
```terraform
data "opsramp_tenant" "example" {}
```
